act_name: Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974
heading: Short title and commencement
title: Short title and commencement
text:
1. Short title and commencement. —(1) This Act may be called the Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974.

(2) It shall come into force at once.

act_name: Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) Act, 1974
heading: Provisions of Article 212 (2) to extend to Provincial Service Tribunals
title: Provisions of Article 212 (2) to extend to Provincial Service Tribunals
text:
2. Provisions of Article 212 (2) to extend to Provincial Service Tribunals. The provisions of clause (2) of Article 212 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan shall extend to the Service Tribunals respectively established under Acts of the Provincial Assemblies for Balochistan, the North-West Frontier Province, the Punjab and Sind.
____________

Last Uploaded on 2.11.2023

1For Statement of Objects and Reasons see Gaz. of P. 1974, Ext., Pt. III, p. 562.
2Ins. by the Provincial Service Tribunal (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) (Amdt.) Act, 1976 (34 of 1976) s. 2.
3Subs. by the Provincial Service Tribunals (Extension of Provisions of the Constitution) (Amdt.) Act. 1976 (34 of 1976). s. 3. For “Provincial Assemblies”.
